name: How often should I have my electrical system inspected in Oakland?

mainEntity.name: How often should I have my electrical system inspected in Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homes in Oakland, especially older properties, an electrical inspection every 5-10 years is recommended. This helps identify outdated wiring, overloaded circuits, and potential fire hazards. Regular inspections ensure your system meets current safety codes and can handle modern electrical demands.
